name: Marunouchi Building Hall & Conference Square
address: Tokyo 100-6307 7F and 8F Marunouchi Building, 2-4-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku
accessSummary: Tokyo Station (JR) Marunouchi South Exit: about 1 min walk / Tokyo Station (Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line), directly connected via the underground passage: about 3 min walk / Nijubashi-mae Station (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line), directly connected: about 4 min walk / Otemachi Station (Toei Mita Line), directly connected: about 10 min walk / Otemachi Station (Tokyo Metro Tozai Line), directly connected: about 11 min walk
hours: Marunouchi Building Hall 9:00-22:00 (rented by the full day) / Conference Square 9:00-21:00

rooms.name: 7F Marunouchi Building Hall
rooms.note: 13 m wide x 28.5 m deep. Theater is 399 seats on a flat floor (stacking chairs). With the electric movable tiered seating, it is 314 seats (234 roll-back chairs plus 80 stacking chairs). Classroom is 240 seats on the flat floor, 3 per desk. A lifting stage (up to 600 mm) is available. The room fee includes 3 waiting rooms, a user office, the lifting stage, the electric movable seating, a pantry, a hot-water room and air conditioning.

rooms.name: 7F Foyer
rooms.note: 13 m wide x 15 m deep. Can be used for a reception desk and for a reception party held together with the event. A bar counter is available.

rooms.name: 8F Room 5
rooms.note: A new room available from October 1, 2026. Minimum use: 4 hours

ops.prevDaySetup: Day-before setup for Marunouchi Building Hall is requested to take place between 9:00 and 22:00. If another booking falls in that time slot, requests for special late-night setup (23:00 to 9:00 the next day) are accepted. Rental hours outside business hours are 7:00-9:00 and 22:00-23:00. The room fee for a setup or teardown day is 770,000 yen per day (up to 2 days in total, excluding tax), and the room fee for a one-day use (9:00-22:00, including setup and teardown time) is 990,000 yen (excluding tax). Day-before setup for Conference Square is also 9:00-22:00, and its rental hours outside business hours are 8:00-9:00 and 21:00-23:00. (Source: FAQ, Marunouchi Building Hall Price List revised October 2026)
ops.loadingHours: Equipment and furnishings brought in are loaded in from B2F of Marunouchi Building. The loading elevator is not for the exclusive use of this facility. The elevator opening is W1450 x H2400 mm (inside the car W1900 x H2650 x D1550 mm), with a load capacity of 1200 kg. The prescribed work notification and the vehicle information for loading in and out must be submitted by 1 week before the use date (FAQ). The usage rules state that if the meeting before use judges that a work notification is needed, it must be submitted by 4 business days before the use date, and that the freight elevator is used when loading in and out with hand carts. The hall on 7F has a loading/unloading elevator (floor plan). (Source: FAQ, Hall Usage Rules revised April 1, 2025, Marunouchi Building Hall Floor Plan)
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles that can park at the loading area in front of the loading elevator must be no more than 2.9 m high, 6.0 m long and 1.8 m wide. When a vehicle is used for loading in or out, submit the prescribed work notification form. (Source: FAQ, Hall Usage Rules revised April 1, 2025)
ops.parking: Use the parking lot on B2F of Marunouchi Building. The number of spaces is limited, and there is no parking fee discount for using Marunouchi Building Hall & Conference Square. If you want a 1-hour ticket, request it in advance. The height limit at the parking lot entrance is 2.9 m. The brochure (September 2026 edition) lists Marunouchi Chuo Parking (Marunouchi Building zone) as open 6:00-24:00, with 409 spaces, a height limit of 3.0 m, a basic fee of 400 yen per 30 minutes, and a long-stay service of 2,800 yen for 3 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours. (Source: FAQ, Brochure September 2026 edition)
ops.waitingRooms: The room fee for Marunouchi Building Hall includes 3 waiting rooms and a user office. The waiting rooms are: (1) about 13㎡, and (2) and (3) about 31㎡ each (ceiling height 2.8 m). Waiting rooms (2) and (3) become one room when the partition is removed. (Source: Brochure September 2026 edition, Marunouchi Building Hall Price List revised October 2026)
ops.catering: Catering can be arranged. Drinks (PET bottles, cups and saucers) and meeting lunch boxes are available. In principle the caterer only delivers to the venue, and the organizer does the serving (serving staff by consultation; party plans include service labor costs). The catering guide page has menus from 8 companies, starting with MARUDELI. Bringing in food and drink incurs a separate carry-in fee; the price list says that bringing in items the facility can arrange is declined and is accepted only when staff give special approval. The carry-in fees are 800 yen per venue participant for a social gathering party, 250 yen per lunch box, 250 yen per bottle of drink (including alcohol), and 1,000 yen per pot of coffee or tea (excluding tax). Trash from food and drink brought in must be taken home. (Source: FAQ, catering page, Conference Square Price List special handling revised April 2026)
